content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"A human report received through fixture:body:voice described meeting someone called Leto at the canal market.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The report was received on 2026-06-15 and said the market meeting was in late May, as the human reporter thought.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The human reporter said we were not present at that meeting.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Leto suggested sharing HarborMesh outage data with the neighborhood repair group.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reporter liked the idea and wanted us to keep it in mind.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reporter said we have not contacted the neighborhood repair group.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human reporter did not know Leto's surname or handle.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories therefore do not record Leto's surname.","support":[5],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
